{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Rebar → `uOpeningRebar`
{{% /callout %}}

Places the reinforcement around a circular or rectangular opening in a slab: trimmers, stub and cut-mesh bars, and for the typical circular detail four tangent diagonals and four corner bars along the bisectors, with a clash check against the other bars. It reuses the Border engine for its sides, and the covers of the bar families stack in layers from the face cover. The tool passes its native suite (5882 assertions) and end-to-end insert tests on Tekla 2026; the typical-detail dialog tab is not yet tested in Tekla.

<blockquote class="page-note">The Tekla plugin string is <code>uOpeningRebar</code>. Components placed by the earlier Clone builds (<code>uOpeningRebarClone</code>) may not be recognised by it; see <a href="../rebar-upgrade/">Upgrading from the earlier Clone builds</a>. Sets saved under the earlier dialog name are carried over with the <a href="../rebar-upgrade/">preset migration helper</a>.</blockquote>
